name: Rasuwa flood
where: Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and downstream, Nepal
headline: Rasuwa flood, live
lede: The Bhote Koshi flood struck Rasuwa on 26 August. Search and recovery continue along the Trishuli and Narayani rivers.

stats.label: confirmed dead
stats.detail: Nepal Police: 1,456. Up from 1,455. Source: https://nepalpolice.gov.np/news/10719/ Earlier note, 17:00 NPT, 9 September, describing a previous figure: NDRRMA and Nepal Police reported 1,367 deaths as of 11:00 NPT on 9 September 2026. Eight recovery districts account for 1,365; two people died after transfer to hospitals in Kathmandu. Source: https://nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin/
stats.priorDetail: NDRRMA and Nepal Police reported 1,367 deaths as of 11:00 NPT on 9 September 2026. Eight recovery districts account for 1,365; two people died after transfer to hospitals in Kathmandu. Source: https://nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin/

stats.label: listed missing in Nepal
stats.detail: NDRRMA: 5,285 people remained missing as of 3 October, Bernama reported. Up from 5,132 on 9 September. Reuters reported the same figure on 5 October, when the government ended the formal search. Missing does not mean confirmed dead. Source: https://bernama.com/en/news.php?id=2615902

stats.label: missing on the China side
stats.detail: Xinhua reports 546 people missing around Gyirong Port in Xizang (Tibet) as of 6pm Saturday, including 261 foreign nationals. Combined with Nepal's 2,502-person list that is 3,048 people unaccounted for across both countries, although the two countries' counts may overlap.

stats.label: rescued so far
stats.detail: Reuters, 5 October: 13,795 people were rescued by the time the formal search ended, citing officials. Up from 13,646 on 9 September. Source: https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2026/10/06/nepal-ends-search-and-rescue-after-flood-focuses-on-rehabilitation

stats.label: hydropower projects damaged
stats.detail: The Nepal Electricity Authority reports 14 projects damaged with a combined capacity of about 748 MW: 9 operating plants (354 MW) and 5 under construction (394 MW). Named ones include Rasuwagadhi, Chilime, Sanjen Khola, Upper Trishuli-1, Trishuli and Devighat, plus a 220 kV substation. An earlier same-day Ministry of Energy estimate said 431 MW.

stats.label: since the flood
stats.detail: Counting from the morning of 26 August 2026, when the flood hit. Search, rescue and recovery work is still going on this many days later.

stats.label: damage, early estimate
stats.detail: Physical Infrastructure Minister Sunil Lamsal put damage to roads and bridges at about Rs 200 billion on 26 August, and called it preliminary. Hydropower and private property are not in that figure. The whole 42 km road from Betrawati to the Rasuwagadhi border crossing was destroyed at multiple points. A separate preliminary National Planning Commission survey, reported by Nepalnews on 26 October, put losses to households and businesses at Rs 79.17 billion. That covers a different part of the damage, so the two are not added together. Source: https://english.nepalnews.com/s/nation/rasuwa-bhote-koshi-floods-cause-over-rs-79-billion-in-damages/

stats.label: relief fund deposited
stats.detail: The Office of the Prime Minister said the Prime Minister's Natural Disaster Rescue Fund and Relief Fund together held Rs 18.136 billion at 9am on 26 October, Onlinekhabar reported. Up from Rs 5.04 billion on 29 August. This is money deposited, not money spent, and it is not the cost of the damage. Source: https://english.onlinekhabar.com/deposits-in-prime-ministers-disaster-relief-funds-exceed-rs-18-13-billion.html

dead.sentence: जसमध्ये रसुवामा २ सय ३७ जना, नुवाकोटमा २ सय ५ जना, धादिङमा ७३ जना, चितवनमा ३ सय ६९ जना, गोरखामा ८० जना, तनहुँमा ३८ जना, नवलपरासी पूर्वमा २ सय ३२ जना र नवलपरासी पश्‍चिममा २ सय २२ जना गरी १ हजार ४ सय ५६ जनाको शव फेला परेको हो

missing.sentence: As many as 1,455 people have been confirmed dead and 5,285 remain missing as of Oct 3, according to the NDRRMA.
